policy: Preserve source masters. Offline alpha cutout and 2x integrated reduction; never download masters in the game.
style: Original warm woodland top-down pixel art, fixed high three-quarter camera, upper-left light, complete silhouettes with clear margins. No ground tiles, text or cast shadow.

assets.brief: Eight isolated table settings: beer, wine, mushroom skewers, cheese, pitcher, bottles, stew, serving tray. Four columns, two rows. Flat magenta cutout background.
Compact clump of five segmented bamboo canes with dry green leaves, shallow grounded moss base, no droplets, transparent background.
Tiny warm-skinned duende in pointed green hat paddling a walnut-shell boat, leaf backrest and cork floats. Two small oar phases, high three-quarter camera. Transparent background.
Low terracotta bowl firmly resting on the ground, lavender and herbs seen from above, no visible underside.
assets.editPrompt: Precise asset background edit only. Keep the exact illustrated grounded terracotta herb planter, its lavender, leaves, pot shape, size, perspective, pixel-art rendering and position. Replace ALL background, black and colored glow, and external shadows with absolutely uniform opaque chroma-key magenta #FF00FF. No gradient, no glow, no floor, no external shadow, no black backdrop. Preserve clean complete silhouette including thin leaves and flowers. Do not add anything. This will be cut out offline for an existing top-down pixel-art game.
